# Subway Seat for Midnight Commander

Panels on walnut with gold directories and marked files, menus and the button bar on the darker chrome, dialogs raised a step, and the diff viewer on the same tinted grounds as every other port. True-color skins need a terminal that sets COLORTERM=truecolor; without it mc falls back to its default skin and says why. To try one without saving it, run `mc -S subway-seat`. mcedit's syntax colors come from your terminal's palette.

[Midnight Commander](https://midnight-commander.org) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/midnight-commander/) · Needs mc 4.8.19+ built with S-Lang

## The quick way

```sh
curl -fsSL https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/install.sh | sh -s -- --only midnight-commander
```

The [installer](../../docs/INSTALL.md) shows its plan and asks once. Add `--flavor tunnel`, `--flavor enamel` or `--flavor auto` for another flavor. To do it yourself, use the files below.

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`subway-seat.ini`](subway-seat.ini) | `~/.local/share/mc/skins/subway-seat.ini` |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`subway-seat-tunnel.ini`](subway-seat-tunnel.ini) | `~/.local/share/mc/skins/subway-seat-tunnel.ini` |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`subway-seat-enamel.ini`](subway-seat-enamel.ini) | `~/.local/share/mc/skins/subway-seat-enamel.ini` |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in the [Midnight-Commander] section of ~/.config/mc/ini, or Options › Appearance (then Options › Save setup):

```ini
skin=subway-seat
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in the [Midnight-Commander] section of ~/.config/mc/ini, or Options › Appearance (then Options › Save setup):

```ini
skin=subway-seat-tunnel
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in the [Midnight-Commander] section of ~/.config/mc/ini, or Options › Appearance (then Options › Save setup):

```ini
skin=subway-seat-enamel
```

## Uninstall

- Delete `~/.local/share/mc/skins/subway-seat.ini`.
- Delete `~/.local/share/mc/skins/subway-seat-tunnel.ini`.
- Delete `~/.local/share/mc/skins/subway-seat-enamel.ini`.
- Remove the line you added to turn it on.
